in_arabic.name: بَشيرَة

in_urdu.name: بشیرہ

in_pashto.name: بشیرہ

in_english.name: Basheerat
in_english.meaning: One who hears and conveys good news, a messenger of glad tidings

In Islamic tradition, Basheerat is considered a blessed name, associated with the attribute of hearing and conveying good news. The name is also mentioned in the Quranic verse 3:3, where the Prophet Muhammad is referred to as 'Bashir al-Husna al-Adheem' (the bringer of good news of the greatest blessings).
